method: SPARQL: instances of video game (P31 Q7889) with an English Wikipedia article and at least 10 sitelinks, under video game; each one's single-medium series (P179 to a P31 Q7058673 video game series, no Q196600 media franchise, one series each, none named like one of its games) under video game with its games under it; title forms; genre (P136, with each genre's broader genres P279+ among those the set uses, racing not under sports) and publisher (P123), whose values are items of the set; a short form two games share goes to the one with more sitelinks
